finding: The retained-evidence manifest and final deployment-attempt decision were individually fail-closed, but no single integration surface recomputed artifact digests from supplied bytes, parsed the retained reconciliation result, built the manifest, and passed only derived evidence into the deployment gate.
design_implication: Deployment-attempt authorization must be derived from retained bytes in one deterministic pipeline; caller-supplied digest and exhaustive-evidence assertions must not bypass byte recomputation or reconciliation verification.

boundaries: Recompute SHA-256 and byte length from each retained artifact.
Build the R-022 manifest from computed descriptors.
Parse reconciliation bytes and require verified=true, exact commit agreement, and provider_ceiling_ambiguous=false.
Feed derived handoff state into the existing Vercel deployment decision.
Keep deployment_claim_permitted=false even when an application build attempt is authorized.
Block operations-only changes from creating application builds.

verification.environment: Local Node test harness reconstructed from exact repository source files fetched before the change.

deployment_evidence.reason: CURRENT_STATE records exhausted provider build capacity and directs operations-only changes until capacity returns.

rollback: Revert commits 353c33c4a921e94495cc06207b5ed2576c9daa1c and 0cde2fffc53b88079294538b6e342c655d96a0ae. No existing runtime path was modified.
limits: The pipeline has not yet consumed authenticated retained artifacts from a real exact-commit collection.
The reconciliation JSON contract is verified structurally only through its bounded fields; authenticity still depends on independently retained bytes and execution provenance.
Authorization means an application build attempt may proceed when all prerequisites are true; it does not prove a deployment exists or is healthy.
No physical iPhone Safari audio verification was performed.
